role: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom
promise: By July 2029, 92% of NHS patients will be seen within 18 weeks for routine hospital treatment
description: Starmer's 'plan for change' pledged that by July 2029, 92 per cent of patients would be seen within 18 weeks for routine elective care such as hip and knee replacements. In March 2026, analysis suggested the NHS would miss the target.
evidence: 18-week target with 92% coverage pledged for July 2029
March 2026 reporting said the NHS was not on track to deliver it

promise: Provide Bolivia a $1.9 billion, 36-month Extended Fund Facility program to restore macroeconomic stability and rebuild foreign reserves
description: The IMF and Bolivia reached a staff-level agreement on July 29, 2026, for a 36-month, about $1.9 billion financing program under the Extended Fund Facility, pending approval by the IMF Executive Board. The program aims to restore macroeconomic stability and rebuild depleted foreign reserves.
evidence: Staff-level agreement announced July 29, 2026; board approval still pending

promise: Extend the Benazir Nashonuma Programme for three years to protect an additional 3.3 million children and women from malnutrition across Pakistan
description: On July 9, 2026, Pakistan's Benazir Income Support Programme (BISP), the World Food Programme, WHO and UNICEF announced a three-year extension of the Benazir Nashonuma Programme (BNP 3.0) to protect an additional 3.3 million pregnant and breastfeeding women and children under two from malnutrition, expanding the programme's reach to about 8 million women and children.
evidence: Joint announcement on July 9, 2026 of the three-year extension
Extension targets an additional 3.3 million children and women
